Game Overview

Bunny Quest puts players into a brain experience centered on guide a lovable bunny through a puzzling adventure, creating paths by dragging tiles. Strategically maneuver through tricky terrain, avoiding grass and uncovering the essential blocks needed to munch on delicious carrots. Embark on this delightful challenge and bring joy to your furry friend!

Bunny Quest keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a lovable bunny through a puzzling adventure, creating paths by dragging tiles.
